changelog:
* **fix: every save to draft creates a new draft** (02c8691)
  - Save to Draft always inserts a new draft instead of silently overwriting the loaded draft, so the draft list can grow without limit.
  - Name drafts from the max existing Draft #N plus one, so numbers are never duplicated after deletions or restores.
  - Remove the now-unused updateDraft repository method and the getDraftCount DAO query.
  - Expose loadedDraftId in CalculatorUiState and show a dialog hint when a draft is loaded: a new draft will be created and the loaded one stays.
  - Update the save toast to New draft saved in English and Bangla.
